_doc: The pool's training job (fixed recipe). GRPO on the pool's tasks with Qwen3.5-2B (thinking on), Miles 3ad61b8 colocated on the box's one GPU (Megatron TP1 with CPU Adam + one SGLang engine), mini-swe-agent 2.4.6 episodes through Miles' in-process Harbor path, task sandboxes from the training broker (1 vCPU, 2 GiB, no network). Each step: tasks_per_step tasks x n episodes, then one optimizer step; the reference canary replays every task's solution/solve.sh next to the step's rollouts. An episode still running after wall_cap_s is stopped and left out of its group's statistics and of the loss.
